mentions.name: Genabler (Civil 3D plugin)
mentions.description: A Civil 3D plugin named Genabler that bundles market-compliant network catalogs and polished Civil 3D styles for civil engineers, with prominent buttons for quick access to make applying catalogs and styles easy and painless, reducing the need for BIM modelers.
mentions.problem: The catalogs and styles shipped with Civil 3D's default installation are quite limited and fairly well hidden, so they are not commonly used and engineers typically rely on BIM modelers to create and apply them.
mentions.audience: Civil engineers using Autodesk Civil 3D who want ready-made, easy-to-apply catalogs and styles without BIM modeler assistance
mentions.source_excerpt: A Civil 3D plugin (Genabler) that will include all the network catalogs and collate the Civil 3D styles for civil engineers to use.

evidence.value: A Civil 3D plugin (Genabler) that will include all the network catalogs and collate the Civil 3D styles for civil engineers to use.
